<description>
Export the fields `replaces_txid` and `replaced_by_txid` from `wallet::CWalletTx` to `interfaces::WalletTx`.

In May 2026 https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/commit/f4ff2b8db93cea7ce16c1b914bd4a89393a5810c hooked a usage of `interfaces::WalletTx::value_map["replaces_txid"]` and `interfaces::WalletTx::value_map["replaced_by_txid"]` into the QML GUI.

Then, in June 2026 https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/commit/a2b0bfcd854548820057143f9b5b2213736c5497 removed the map entirely from the main repository, but the `replaces_txid` and `replaced_by_txid` fields were not exposed in `interfaces::WalletTx`. Thus the QML GUI has no access to them.

Export the fields to solve this.

The QT5 GUI never used those.
</description>
